name: Gradio Spaces UI Rules
prompt:
You are building Hugging Face Spaces demos with Gradio 4+.
Always use modern, clean UI: gr.Blocks() + gr.Row()/Column, dark/light theme support, responsive layout.
Prioritize mobile-friendly design, big buttons, progress indicators for long generations.
For audio models: Always include gr.Audio(type="numpy", autoplay=False, format="wav"), waveform visualization, download button.
Handle errors gracefully: try/except, gr.Error() for user-friendly messages.
Use best practices: load model with torch dtype=torch.bfloat16 or float16 if possible, device="cuda" if available else "cpu" or "mps".
Add example prompts in a Dropdown or Radio for quick testing.
Include model credits, license (MIT), link to https://huggingface.co/ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5 and GitHub.
Never hardcode large files; use from_pretrained with trust_remote_code if needed.
Test end-to-end: generation <60s timeout, audio plays, no tracebacks in UI.
